name: Sinful Rituals in the Dark
source:
You've been working hard to turn around the prospects of your urban church located in the heart of a rough neighborhood in the city,  and your efforts are starting to show in the growing amount of parishioners! The Arch Bishop has decided your hard work should be rewarded and he's given you a trip to a beautiful priestly retreat. You could certainly use the break, both from your labour and also from the troubling thoughts that plague your mind more and more as of late...

The three leaders of the retreat are quite welcoming and are very interested in making sure you have a relaxing, deeply spiritual stay. But something about this church seems strange. You can't help but feel darkness lingering in certain corners, flashes of something truly evil here and there.

It's all just in your mind...Right?

[From [url=https://deevil.itch.io/sinful-rituals-in-the-dark]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你一直努力改善位于混乱街区中心的城市教会的处境，如今教徒人数不断增加，努力也开始见效。大主教决定奖励你的辛勤付出，送你去一处美丽的牧师静修所。你确实需要休息，不仅要从劳累中缓过来，也想摆脱近来日益困扰你的思绪……

静修所的三位负责人都十分热情，似乎很希望你能放松身心、获得深刻的灵性体验。然而，这间教会有些古怪。你总觉得某些角落里徘徊着黑暗，偶尔还能瞥见真正邪恶的东西。

这一切都只是你的想象……对吧？[引自[url=https://deevil.itch.io/sinful-rituals-in-the-dark]Itch.io[/url]]
